ViridianCityYoungster1Text.en:
That Monster Ball you have attached at (your) waist...! (It's) unmistakably a Pokémon, isn't it!

That taking out and putting in of Pokémon can be done freely any time, what a convenient world it is.

ViridianCityGambler1Text.GymAlwaysClosed.en:
Whenever (I) come, this Pokémon gym is shut.

What kind of fellow on earth is doing the leader (job), (I) wonder?

ViridianCityGambler1Text.GymLeaderReturn.en: The leader of the Tokiwa gym has come back!

ViridianCityYoungster2Text.YouWantToKnow.en: Don't (you) know there are two kinds of caterpillar Pokémon?

ViridianCityYoungster2Text.CaterpieAndWe.en:
Caterpie has no poison, but Beedle has poison.

So that (your) Pokémon doesn't get stung, let's be careful.

ViridianCityGirlText.HasntHadHisCoffeeYe.en: Oh dear, grandpa! Ending up asleep in a place like this, it can't be helped! Until the drunkenness wears off, there's nothing to do but wait.

ViridianCityGirlText.WhenIGoShopText.en:
Sometimes (I) go as far as Nibi City for shopping, but...

The Tokiwa Forest, the road winds and twists, you know.

ViridianCityOldManSleepyText.PrivateProp.en:
Urgh! Hic... Wait, damn you! Listen to my talk!

...Hey! Don't go! (I'm) telling you!
ViridianCityOldManSleepyText.PrivateProp.who: Old man in Viridian City, drunk

ViridianCityFisherText.YouCanHaveThisTex.en:
Yawn! (I) was basking in the sun and fell asleep!

...(I) saw a strange dream. A Sleep was eating the dream! ...Huh? Before I knew it, I have a move machine, but?

Hmm, (it's) creepy! I'll give this to you!

ViridianCityFisherText.ReceivedTM42Text.en: {player} received Move Machine 42 from the guy!

ViridianCityFisherText.TM42ExplanationTe.en: The contents of Move Machine 42 are... Dream Eater... ...Zzz...

ViridianCityOldManText.HadMyCoffeeNowTex.en:
Hmm... (I) seem to have been drunk!

(My) head hurts...

By the way, in a hurry... are you?

ViridianCityOldManText.KnowHowToCatchPok.en:
Ho ho! Making a Pokédex, are you.

Then, advice from me! If (you) catch Pokémon and examine them, the pages increase automatically!

What, (you) don't know how to catch them!

Well then... shall I show (you) an example!

ViridianCityOldManText.TimeIsMoneyText.en: Time is money... ...time is money, eh.

ViridianCityOldManYouNeedToWeakenTheTarg.en: In the beginning, the trick is to weaken the Pokémon first and then take it!

ViridianCitySignText.en: Here is Tokiwa City. Tokiwa is green, the color of eternity.

ViridianCityTrainerTips1Text.en:
...A bargain bulletin board!

Anyway, catch Pokémon and increase them steadily! In matches with trainers too, having many is an advantage!

ViridianCityTrainerTips2Text.en:
...A bargain bulletin board!

Besides stamina, Pokémon have power points, the source of energy for letting out moves.

Also when the power points for each move have run out, let them rest at a Pokémon Center!

ViridianCityGymLockedText.en: On the door of the Tokiwa gym a key was hanging...!
ViridianCityGymLockedText.loose: The Tokiwa gym's door was locked.

ViridianPokecenterGentlemanText.en:
The computer in the corner, please, use it freely!

...so the young lady at reception was saying. Kind, isn't she.

ViridianPokecenterCooltrainerMText.en:
Pokémon Centers, from here on, exist whatever town (you) go to!

However many (Pokémon you) deposit, (it's) free, so using them often is good!

ViridianMartClerkSayHiToOakText.en: Well! Give (my) regards to Professor Okido!

ViridianMartClerkYouCameFromPalletTownTe.en: Oh! You came from Masara Town, didn't you?

ViridianMartClerkParcelQuestText.en:
(You) know Professor Okido, right?

(I've) been asked (to deliver) this, would you hand it over!

{player} took charge of a delivery from the shop!

ViridianMartYoungsterText.en: Hey, this shop's best seller is antidote, they say!

ViridianMartCooltrainerMText.en: There isn't any, wound medicine... Here it seems to be sold out.

ViridianSchoolHouseBrunetteGirlText.en: Phew. The things inside the notebook, I'm memorizing all of them.

ViridianSchoolHouseCooltrainerFText.en:
Yes!

What is written on the blackboard, look at it properly!

ViridianNicknameHouseBaldingGuyText.en:
Thinking up nicknames is fun... but difficult!

Elaborate nicknames are fine too, but easy to remember is number one, right!
ViridianNicknameHouseBaldingGuyText.who: Balding man in the nickname house

ViridianNicknameHouseLittleGirlText.who: Little girl in the nickname house

Called up the Pokémon deposit system!

AccessedSomeonesPCText.en:
Connected with someone's computer!

Called up the Pokémon deposit system!

ParlyzHealText.en: The numbness of {name}'s body came off.

ItemUseBallText00.en: (It) was dodged! This one looks like it won't be caught!

ItemUseBallText02.en: Too bad! The Pokémon came out of the ball!

ItemUseBallText03.en: Ah! And (I) thought (I) had caught it!

ItemUseBallText04.en: So close! (It) was just a little bit more!

ItemUseBallText06.en: {enemy}'s data will be newly saved in the Pokédex!

TeachMachineMoveText.en:
Inside, {name} was recorded!

Make a Pokémon learn {name}?

MonCannotLearnMachineMoveText.en:
{name} and {name} had bad compatibility!

{name} cannot learn (it)!

ItemUseNotTimeText.en: Okido's words... {player}! For things like this there is a time to use them!

ItemUseNotYoursToUseText.en: (It's) an important thing (you) were entrusted with! Using it cannot be done!

TooImportantToTossText.en: That is a very important thing. Throwing it away cannot be done!

DisplayBattleMenu.loose: Shown as the trainer name while the old man demonstrates catching.

PokemartGreetingText.en: Welcome! Is there something (you're) looking for?

MartSignText.en: Full of Pokémon goods! Friendly Shop

BuySellQuitText.en:
Came to buy
Came to sell
Nothing in particular

PokemonCenterWelcomeText.en:
Welcome! To the Pokémon Center.

Here (we) do stamina recovery of Pokémon.

NeedYourPokemonText.en: Well then, (I) will humbly take them into (my) care!

PokemonFightingFitText.en: Thank you for waiting! The Pokémon (we) took care of have all become healthy!

PokemonCenterFarewellText.loose: We hope to see you again!

PokemartTellBuyPriceText.en: {name}, is it. That comes to {n} yen, but (is that okay)?

PokemartBoughtItemText.en: Yes, here you are. Thank you, as always.

PokemartItemBagFullText.en: (You) can't carry more than that. Please sort out things (you) don't need.

PokemartTellSellPriceText.en: If (it's) that, (we) shall take it off (your) hands for {n} yen.

PokemartItemBagEmptyText.en: (You) don't seem to have goods (we) can buy.

PokemartUnsellableItemText.en: ...(We) cannot put a price on that item.

PokemartAnythingElseText.en: Is there anything else we can be of help with?

LinkCableHelpText1.en:
...Pokémon lecture!

About how to play using the communication cable.

HowToLinkText.en:
To play with the cable
Colosseum
Trade Center
Stop reading

LinkCableInfoText1.en: Once (you) connect with a friend's Game Boy by cable, the young lady at the counter on the right side of the Pokémon Center will guide (you).

LinkCableInfoText2.en: The Colosseum is the room (you) enter when battling with a friend.

LinkCableInfoText3.en: The Trade Center is the room (you) enter when exchanging Pokémon with a friend.

ViridianSchoolBlackboardText1.en: On the blackboard is written about the changes of condition that happen while Pokémon are fighting.

ViridianBlackboardSleepText.en:
When (it) ends up asleep, during that interval (it) cannot attack!

Even when the fight ends (it) stays asleep. With a sleep-waker (its) eyes open.

ViridianBlackboardPoisonText.en:
When (it) takes poison, (its) stamina keeps decreasing.

Even when the fight ends the poison remains, but with an antidote it disappears!

ViridianBlackboardPrlzText.en:
When paralyzed, moves sometimes stop coming out!

Even when the fight ends the paralysis remains. Also, with a paralysis-healer it heals.

ViridianBlackboardBurnText.en:
A burn decreases stamina, and attack power and speed also end up going down!

Even when the fight ends the burn remains. Also, with a burn-healer it heals.

ViridianBlackboardFrozenText.en:
When (it) ends up frozen, (it) becomes completely unable to move!

Even when the fight ends (it) stays frozen. If (you) don't thaw (it) with an ice-healer, the poor Pokémon.

TMNotebook.en:
(It's) a pamphlet on move machines! ......

Move machines, fifty kinds in all!

Secret machines are the type that doesn't run out even when used. There are five kinds in all.

...Silph Company

ViridianSchoolNotebookText1.en:
Peeked into the notebook!

Page 1...

Pokémon are caught with Monster Balls, and up to six can be carried around.

A person who raises Pokémon and makes them fight is called a Pokémon trainer.

ViridianSchoolNotebookText2.en:
Page 2...

When catching Pokémon, first weaken them! Weakening them with poison or burns is fine too!

If (they're) healthy, (you) may not be able to take them well.

ViridianSchoolNotebookText3.en:
Page 3...

Making Pokémon fight each other and winning is, for a trainer, the greatest joy!

At the Pokémon gyms in each region, fierce fights are always unfolding!

ViridianSchoolNotebookText4.en:
Page 4...

The goal of a Pokémon trainer is to defeat the strong trainers in the gyms of each region, the group of eight!

Furthermore, at the Pokémon League headquarters... fiercely strong! The Four Heavenly Kings reign!
ViridianSchoolNotebookText4.loose: The Four Heavenly Kings are the Elite Four.
